items.raw_excerpt: More than 40,000 spectators attended the "modern day corroboree" on Worimi Country at Raymond Terrace in New South Wales.
items.summary_en: Two Aboriginal teams won the Koori Knockout, a big Indigenous rugby league event. More than 40,000 people watched the games on Worimi Country in Raymond Terrace, New South Wales. It is the largest gathering of Aboriginal people in Australia.
items.summary_ko: 두 원주민 럭비 팀이 큰 행사인 쿠리 녹아웃에서 우승했다. 뉴사우스웨일스주 레이먼드 테라스에서 열린 이 대회에는 4만 명이 넘는 관중이 모였다. 호주에서 가장 큰 원주민 모임으로 알려져 있다.
items.title_en: Indigenous rugby teams win big at Koori Knockout
items.title_ko: 쿠리 녹아웃 대회에서 원주민 럭비 팀 우승
items.title_original: Wiradjuri Aboriginal Rivers, Newcastle Yowies claim Koori Knockout glory

items.raw_excerpt: The WA government is weighing up future plans for a desalination plant in Esperance as work on a $543 million upgrade to the historic Goldfields water pipeline ramps up.
items.summary_en: The Western Australia government is now considering a desalination plant in Esperance. A desalination plant turns seawater into drinking water. The plan comes as work speeds up on a 543 million dollar upgrade to the historic Goldfields water pipeline.
items.summary_ko: 서호주 정부가 에스퍼란스에 해수담수 시설을 짓는 방안을 다시 검토하고 있다. 담수 시설은 바닷물을 식수로 바꾸는 곳이다. 이번 계획은 오래된 골드필즈 수송관을 5억 4300만 달러에 걸쳐 고치는 공사가 빨라지는 가운데 나왔다.
items.title_en: Western Australia changes course on desalination plant during big pipeline upgrade

items.title_original: WA premier backflips on desalination plant amid $543m pipeline upgrade

items.raw_excerpt: Candidato ao governo de Pernambuco votou neste domingo (4) no bairro do Pina, na Zona Sul do Recife.
items.summary_en: Renan Hallais, a candidate for governor of Pernambuco, voted on Sunday. He cast his ballot at a school in the Pina neighborhood in the south of Recife.

items.raw_excerpt: Netherlands retirement towns like Edam, Bolsward, and Willemstad offer weekly markets, walkable centers, and festivals that bring communities together.
items.summary_en: Towns like Edam, Bolsward, and Willemstad are popular places to retire in the Netherlands. They have weekly markets, walkable centers, and festivals that bring people together.
items.summary_ko: 에담, 볼스바르트, 빌렘스타트 같은 마을은 네덜란드에서 은퇴 생활지로 인기가 높다. 주말 시장과 걸어서 다닐 수 있는 중심가, 그리고 주민들을 하나로 모으는 축제가 있다.
items.title_en: 8 Friendliest Towns to Retire in the Netherlands

items.summary_en: A large exhibit of art from Uppsala University is now on show at the Zorn Museum. The collection brings together many of the university's most treasured works. Visitors can see the pieces in Mora, Sweden.

items.raw_excerpt: Like most countries, Switzerland doesn’t grant non-citizens a right to vote and, therefore, have a direct say in how their host country is being run. But there are ways foreign residents can get involved.
items.summary_en: Foreigners in Switzerland cannot vote in national elections. But there are ways they can still take part in local life. This guide explains how they can get involved.
items.summary_ko: 스위스에 사는 외국인은 국가 선거에서 투표할 수 없다. 하지만 지역 생활에 참여할 수 있는 방법은 여러 가지다. 이 기사에서는 그 방법을 소개한다.
items.title_en: How foreigners in Switzerland can join local life
